get_flops_profile: run a FLOPs profiler on a PyTorch model with input data to measure computational cost
get_flops_profile_verbose: run a FLOPs profiler on a model with verbose output to print the detailed model profile
review_get_flops_profile: review the get_flops_profile function that profiles a model's FLOPs using flops-profiler
refactor_get_flops_profile: refactor get_flops_profile to support batched input data for FLOPs profiling
test_get_flops_profile: test the get_flops_profile function with a sample model and dummy input tensor
